basic_profile.bio: Avid fantasy literature enthusiast and world-builder based in Portland, Oregon. I've been diving deep into the Malazan Book of the Fallen series for over a decade, which has fueled my passion for epic storytelling and complex character arcs. When I'm not engrossed in a book, I enjoy crafting maps of fictional worlds and exploring the intricacies of narrative structure. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my reading and creative projects. Happily married with two cats who often join my late-night reading sessions. Typically online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in English Literature and have spent countless hours dissecting fantasy novels and their world-building elements. My expertise is largely self-developed through years of reading, engaging in online discussions, and creating fan content. I've also attended several workshops on creative writing and map-making.
